Oct 2026 • Family
I honestly can’t say enough good things about Mr. Dragon! What started as a simple visit to his restaurant turned into one of the most genuine and memorable experiences I’ve had in Vietnam.

Mr. Dragon is not only an incredible host but an even better human being. He’s extremely hospitable, kindhearted, genuine, and family-oriented. He took time out of his day to personally show me around, share stories, and get to know me as a person. I even had the pleasure of meeting his family, which made the experience that much more special.

Coming from New York City, where everyone is constantly rushing and barely has time for one another, this level of hospitality is almost unheard of. He didn’t treat me like another customer or tourist. He made me feel like family.

What stood out to me most wasn’t just the restaurant experience, but the genuine connection we made. I truly loved Mr. Dragon as a person, and his kindness is something I’ll never forget.

Being thousands of miles away from home, he somehow made me feel right at home. I’ll definitely be coming back, not just for the restaurant, but to see Mr. Dragon and his family again.

Thank you, Mr. Dragon, for reminding me that the best part of traveling isn’t always the places you visit, but the incredible people you meet along the way. Highly recommended!

The rest of the dishes were alright but was slightly more on the saltier side considering my palate.

It is possible to order it steamed if you would like a more original taste of the snake itself.

The wine on the table (white/transparent bottle) that has the snake in it is actually drinkable but it is more pungent.

Tasting Cobra in Hanoi: An Epic Food Adventure
Apr 2025 • Couples
Hung Snake Restaurant is one of the most unique dining experiences we had in Hanoi. This restaurant has been in the Hung family for 30 years, and they’ve perfected traditional Vietnamese snake cuisine in a warm, welcoming and beautiful setting. 

The owner, Dragon, is incredibly gracious and attentive—reservations were easy to make via WhatsApp, and he made sure we knew to contact him with any questions. Before the meal, he invited us to see the live snakes and we even got to hold a bamboo snake, which was really amazing! We opted for the cobra, as a once-in-a-lifetime experience. The meal itself was a multi-course feast, expertly prepared by Dragon’s wife and included cobra dishes ranging from spring rolls to minced snake ribs to grilled specialties and even a super-flavorful stir fry with pineapple and onions. Every dish was delicious and thoughtfully presented. 

While Hung Snake Restaurant might be considered a place for adventurous eaters, even those who might be hesitant about eating snake will enjoy these delicious dishes. And everyone will appreciate Dragon’s hospitality and the care that he and his family put into every detail. Dragon and his family create an experience that goes far beyond just dinner—it's something we'll be talking about long after we leave Hanoi. Thanks again, Dragon, for a very special dining experience!
